therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: c-MET pathway inhibition to overcome cetuximab resistance
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Cetuximab-resistant, recurrent or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma

results.effect_size: Median PFS: 1.8 months (ficlatuzumab alone) vs 3.7 months (ficlatuzumab + cetuximab), p=0.04
biomarker_changes: HGF expression evaluated in HPV-positive and HPV-negative patients
c-MET positive in 9/13 HPV-negative patients and 2/13 HPV-positive patients
Cox HR 0.3 (95% CI: 0.1-0.8, p=0.02) for one biomarker analysis
Cox HR 0.1 (95% CI: 0.03-0.8, p=0.03) for another biomarker analysis
subgroup_findings: Overall response rate: 1/26 ficlatuzumab alone vs 6/32 ficlatuzumab + cetuximab
Median OS: 6.4 months ficlatuzumab alone vs 7.4 months ficlatuzumab + cetuximab
safety_signals: Serious adverse events including pneumonitis, thromboembolic events, hemorrhage
results.dose_information: Given IV, specific dosing not provided

context.comparator: Ficlatuzumab monotherapy vs ficlatuzumab + cetuximab combination
